description: Leaving José María Root behind, Camilo, Eva and their friends step into adult life with far less certainty than they expected. Camilo struggles to balance his relationship with Eva against his responsibilities as Luisa's co-parent, Luisa and Arbeláez grow closer, and the group fights to stay intact as university, work, family and politics pull them apart. Eva's connection to Professor Silva and political activism eventually places her under police scrutiny, turning the group's new independence into a much more dangerous test.

s03e01.description: Final examinations force the José María Root students to confront whether they will graduate and what happens immediately afterward. Camilo recruits the Acuña brothers for an illicit plan connected to those academic pressures, while José continues trying to rebuild his relationship with Ana despite her insistence on independence.

s03e02.description: The military examination required of the boys divides Salcedo, Pabón, Castro and Arbeláez over service, fear and obligation. At the same time a school stage production introduces someone who becomes important to Salcedo, pulling him toward a part of himself and a social world he has not previously confronted openly.

s03e03.description: Military conscription threatens to scatter the group just before graduation, forcing the boys to make choices about service rather than treating adulthood as an abstract future. Eva's own commitments increasingly compete with her relationship with Camilo, and the uncertainty around both their plans begins to separate them.

s03e04.description: Graduation opens different opportunities for the friends while military life creates a direct conflict between Pabón and Quiñónez. Lucy makes a decision about her own future that José resists, extending the struggle over independence inside the Granados family even as the younger generation starts leaving school behind.

s03e05.description: Camilo, Eva and their friends begin organizing life after José María Root instead of around the routines that kept them together at school. Janet proposes a change that catches José off guard, while Pabón gains leverage in his conflict with Quiñónez and refuses to accept the role military authority has assigned him.

s03e06.description: Pabón chooses to help Quiñónez despite their conflict, while Camilo becomes increasingly jealous of Eva's intellectual and personal interest in Professor Silva. A night of drinking exposes the depth of Camilo's insecurity, and Ana receives news that moves her own plans forward independently of José.

s03e07.description: Camilo's jealousy intensifies as Eva keeps more of her relationship with Professor Silva and her political activity from him. Pabón challenges a military decision affecting his future, while José asks Camilo for help with a family matter that forces father and son to cooperate despite their recurring disagreements.

s03e08.description: Eva makes a decision that ends the version of their relationship Camilo had been trying to preserve, and he responds by spiraling rather than accepting it. Salcedo's growing drug use begins affecting the wider group, while Camilo is offered a new creative opportunity that gives him a direction outside Eva.

s03e09.description: Police search for Eva because Professor Silva is connected to an urban guerrilla organization, forcing her to hide at the house on 364 while the group arranges an escape during a party. Quiñónez finds her but refuses to betray her; Pascual eventually gives her up for money, and after her father secures her release Eva cuts ties with Silva.

s03e10.description: Álvaro suffers a severe football injury that ends his playing ambitions, while Pabón confronts Quiñónez and Gustavo leaves military service after rejecting Quiñónez's feelings. Luisa and Rodrigo marry, Alfredo survives a suicide attempt after asking Eva to reconsider him, and Eva chooses Camilo; by the end Camilo has also turned his writing into a published novel.
